title: Base change, affineness and properness for finite morphisms
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a finite morphism of schemes [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. (a) For every morphism $g:Y'\to Y$, the projection $f':X\times_YY'\to Y'$ from the fibre product [def-pc-base-change] is finite. (b) If $Y$ is affine [def-pc-scheme], then $X$ is affine. (c) If $h:Y\to S$ is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], then $h\circ f:X\to S$ is proper; in particular, if $Y$ is proper over a field $k$, so is $X$ (with structure morphism $h\circ f$).

source.place: Stacks, Morphisms, Lemma 01WL (finite morphisms are stable under base change), Lemma 01WM/01S8 (finite morphisms are affine; an affine morphism to an affine scheme has affine source), Lemma 01WN (finite morphisms are proper) and Lemma 01W0 (composition of proper morphisms); used in the proof of Etale Cohomology Lemma 0A5D for the assertions (2), (5), (6)-(8).
